data: What is the value represented by the darkest purple cell in the confusion matrix shown in Figure 1?

The darkest purple cell represents the value of 94. This can be determined by analyzing the color gradient scale on the right side of the figure, which indicates that darker shades of purple correspond to lower values. The darkest purple cell is located at the intersection of the row labeled "OFF" and the column labeled "NOT," where the value 94 is displayed.
